headline: Is something still blocking my money, or have I run out of time?
note:
FRAME: money — the strictest guard on the funnel. No amount, no date, no source, no financial advice, never blames her, never 'too late', never presumes she is broke.

🔴 Beat 4 says the money has not LANDED or not STAYED — never that she has none. Her own ad asserts the block, so restating it is her premise, not our claim.

⚠ NO FAMILY-LINE LANGUAGE. The six beats never need it; naming an inheritance is the shortest path to the authorship ban.

FINDING: 'she has not run out of time' — beat 5a 'open road' and beat 5b 'a hold, not an ending'.

⛔ 'you have run out of time' is banned outright. The read never uses the words in either direction; it says what the cards show instead — a hold, and road left.

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing told the backs apart, and you took the one who came ready.
Look at his table. A cup, a coin, a blade and a wand, all four in the open.
You asked if something is blocking your money, or if time has gone. What catches me is that all four are still out.
And yet it hasn't landed. And you've offered me the harder half yourself.
Whatever is here holds without moving, and it doesn't come and go. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's got hold of it…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. Face down, all three, and yours was held at one ankle.
Look at the rope. One line, one ankle, and nothing else.
You asked if something is blocking your money, or if time has gone. It's the rope and the beam I keep looking at.
Still, it hasn't come through. And you're asking me to rule between the two.
Something is sitting in front of it, close in. I don't think this began with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing showed through the backs, and yours was the one in full sun.
Look at the sky behind him. Gold, and no cloud anywhere in it.
You asked if something is blocking your money, or if time has gone. A bright day, and a lifted foot.
But it hasn't landed. And you're the one asking which of the two it is.
Something turns up right at the point it would come. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what's there…
